task.title: P6-137: Make sets past the pickers 25-row window reachable with a match count indicator
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Catalog, search and paging). Original id: P6-137. Size: S. Specs: specs/catalog-search.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**A set past the picker's 25-row window is silently unreachable** (was `P6-036a`; **mechanism corrected 2026-07-30** — the entry blamed the SQL, but `hosted.rs:345,352` *does* bind `query.limit()` into `LIMIT $2`). The real gap is `lib.rs:352-355`, which always passes `limit: None`, plus the absence of any match count or "N more" indicator: `q=commander` matches 108 sets in the dev catalog and shows 25, newest-first, so only the query bar can name the rest.
